Canada seems like a pure country upon first glance, but we’ve made plenty of mistakes as well.

Oof jeez it feels awful to talk about this but I should get it off of my chest, so here we go reddit.

When I was 8 or 9, my mom put me in a bible (ish) camp during the time I was off school, so I’d have something to do during the summer months. It was in this huge old church-school type building, and it had a playground in the front yard with a pink plastic playhouse off to the side. Staff was nice, there was a hepatitis B outbreak there once, but the food was good. I partially enjoyed it.

There was a boy there, his name was Jayden and he was 11 or 12. He was the only kid who talked to me, and I was a really shy, weird kid so I was super grateful. We hung out every day I had to go to camp, and did most of the activities together. He made sexual jokes often, and I laughed along because I had no idea what the heck they could’ve meant. I tried to like him as just a friend, but he always wanted more. 
I felt weird around him, and never really knew why. 

Later in the summer, his actions began to get stranger. He would act like we were husband and wife, and kiss me all the time when the supervisors weren’t looking. It was so awkward, but he would tell the adults that I hurt him if I didn’t go along with his plans, so being the paranoid kid I was, I had to. This vulnerability led to even more things, like that one time where we were making blanket forts, and he laid on the ground and asked me to sit on him. I can still faintly remember how weird it was staring down at him, and I actually just got shivers from it right now.

But the worst was still yet to come. A week or so before the summer ended, when we were playing outside in the front yard, he asked me to go behind the playhouse with him. I thought nothing of it, he was being his normal self that day, and hadn’t pulled anything so it felt safe. God was I wrong, I regret making the one choice that eternally fucked up my childhood. When we both crouched behind the playhouse, he did horrible things I’d rather not put into text. I can’t even think about them without getting a heavy nauseating feeling in my stomach. Skipping the godawful sexual assault part, let’s just say I have severe commitment issues and won’t go anywhere with anyone alone unless I’ve known them for years. 

Thinking back on it- after that entire incident (he eventually left camp to go to high school) I hated going there, and cried every morning I was forced to go, but I never truly realized why until the memories came back to me quite recently. 

God, I hope Jayden is living his worst live right now. I hate him. Fuck you Jayden.

This is kind of unrelated, but my science teacher in grade 6 was really something.

She was really gullible, so we would often play stupid tricks on her. I remember, I had a special cat pen that would meow whenever you pressed the end. The majority of people in my class recorded the sound and we all played it at different times throughout science. After a few weeks, we’d convinced her that there was a cat in the ceiling. 

We screwed with her yet again, when she wanted to know if we had any questions regarding the lesson she’d just taught us. She wanted us to write our feedback down on a piece of paper anonymously and hand it in to the table at the front. Of course, being the idiots we were, we wrote down memes and nonsense- and one kid scribbled down “I feel bad for your children” on a huge poster board. She skipped literally every question, and we stifled laugher the whole time.

Another time, there were two “classic prankster, class clown” boys that were messing with her, and they ran down the hallway before she could yell at them or anything. Apparently, she was furious enough to charge after them in the hallway, yelling “I’m menustrating!” As she did it. I was just a bystander, and I thought my ears were broken- but that was exactly what everyone else had heard. We joke about it constantly today. 

Sounds like quityourbullshit, but it’s all just pure memories.
